prompt:
Image 1 is the camera and pose guide: a grey clay maquette rendered from the game's battle camera, with the leaves painted in the god's colour. Copy from it exactly the camera angle, the direction the tree faces, its pose, and its size and place in the frame. Do not copy its smooth clay surfaces, its simplified shapes or the thickness of its limbs: the anatomy, the face and every ornament follow Image 2 and the description.
Image 2 is this god's own approved painted portrait: paint the same tree, with the same shapes, colours, materials and marks, now seen full length from above at the battle camera, in the same painting style. Do not copy its dark background, its candlelight or its framing.

One large painted tree, full length, alone in the image on a perfectly flat, uniform pure magenta (#FF00FF) background, as a game cutout. Pose: standing still, the dome canopy spread wide over the trunk.

Camera: high above and to one side, looking down at about 40 degrees, the way a player looks down at a miniature on a table; orthographic, with no perspective. A tree has no front: we look down on its dome canopy from high above at 40 degrees, the trunk and the roots below it. It is foreshortened as seen from above: the top of the canopy is large and the trunk short.

Light: outdoor daylight; the tree stays as dark and as muted as in its portrait, lit only by small warm and cool highlights, never washed out or brightened. A high sun in the upper left of the image lights the top of the canopy, the upper surfaces and the upper-left side of the tree with warm highlights; a cool blue-grey sky fill lies in the shadows on the lower-right side. No candlelight, no dramatic dark shadows, nothing glows unless the description below says so. No cast shadow on the background.

Painting style: painterly oil on a wood panel, visible directional brushwork, moderate detail, the same hand as the painted portrait; a muted earthy palette with the god's own colours as its portrait shows them, in which the leaves in deep bottle green, the green of jade in shade (#1F6A50), the Thornwood's colour is the one clear hue; soft painterly edges, with small crisp highlights on metal edges and a thin bright rim of light along the upper-left edges of the tree. The tree has a strong, simple, readable silhouette that still reads when it is shrunk to 120 pixels tall. It is not a cartoon: no cel shading, no thick black outlines, no chibi or big-headed proportions, no glossy 3D render, no pixel art.

The god: the World Tree, an immobile god that is one vast, ancient tree. Colours: muted and earthy. The one clear colour of the tree is its leaves: deep bottle green, the green of jade in shade, clearly coloured, never grey, slate, olive or yellow-green (#1F6A50), the Thornwood's colour. Nothing in the image glows. No other saturated area larger than a small clasp or trim.
Body: a vast, ancient tree with a thick, straight, massive trunk of ridged dark oak-brown bark (#6B4A2B) in deep vertical ridges; no face, no eyes and no carved features anywhere in the trunk. Canopy: a round, dense, dome-shaped crown of foliage, its leaves deep bottle green, the green of jade in shade, clearly coloured, never grey, slate, olive or yellow-green (#1F6A50), the Thornwood's colour, lit warm on the upper left; no blossom and no fruit. Roots: huge roots spread out from the base of the trunk and grip the ground.

Size: the tree fills about 86% of the image along its longest side, placed as in Image 1, with at least 24 pixels of clean background all around; nothing is cropped.

Background: one flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) colour fills the whole image with no gradient, texture, floor, vignette or shadow. No pink, purple or magenta anywhere on the figure: no pink cloth, no pink glow, no pink reflections; its greens stay green.

Never: text, letters, numbers, labels, grid lines, borders, frames, signatures, logos; a floor, ground, scenery or cast shadows; blood; other creatures or people; a cropped figure; smoke, flames, sparks, floating embers or mist.
